items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He came out with Pete Fountain's small band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Cook?

ctx.x: I just didn't think he had any... He just played...
He came out with Pete Fountain's small band. I think it... Maybe he was for a while with even Lawrence Welk. I don't recall. What is it?
